programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: In the near future, a virus of epic proportions has overtaken the planet. There are more Infected than Uninfected, and humanity is losing its grip on survival. Its only hope is finding a cure. After the fall of New York, Lauren - a doctor - has come to Los Angeles to lead the charge in the hunt for Uninfected survivors, and rescue her family barricaded in their LA home. Lauren's objective is simple: lead her team into the field and rescue survivors, filming their experiences so it can be used for research. But nothing could have prepared them for the mayhem they walk into. As they search for Uninfected, fend off the Infected with whatever weapons they can find, and fight for their lives, we see everything from their point of view - directly from their helmet cameras.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 6: Redemption
programme.desc: A rare first edition from a pioneer author goes missing in the mystery novels-specialized Kinsey bookshop during remodeling by the local firm of Tyler Dell, who recently lost his father, a Vietnam veteran. Retired English teacher Jim Carter, who overheard everything, is murdered shortly after a row in Reverend Tucker's homeless shelter Haven with aggressive lush Murphy. Rude police chief Connors isn't up to an investigation while the killer keeps sniping, so the bookstore's armchair sleuths duo does it alone, starting from a lacquered box left by Jim for his illegitimate daughter, who never even knew his name. It starts a set of cues, slowly unraveling a grim intrigue starting during a 1965 US illegal intrusion into Red Khmer territory.

programme.title: Meet The Santas
programme.desc: Steve Guttenberg stars in the comedy sequel to ʻSingle Santa Seeks Mrs Clausʼ. Shortly before he is due to take on his fatherʼs mantle, the son of Santa plans to wed on Christmas Eve. His fiancéeʼs prim-and-proper society mother disapproves of her choice of husband and insists on controlling every aspect of the wedding. Can Nick Claus win over his in-laws and ensure that the ceremony goes smoothly?

programme.title: The Pledge/A Gunfighter's Pledge
programme.desc: Ex-lawman Matt Austin (Luke Perry) accidentally kills an innocent man (Alex Paez) while hunting an outlaw who killed his family. He pledges to the dying man that he will take his body to his sister Amaya (Jaclyn DeSantis). Austin wrestles with the idea of telling her he caused the death, but is faced with bigger battles once at the farm. There he gets involved with land baron Horn (C. Thomas Howell), who is trying to take Amaya's land. Their lives are more intertwined than he thought, when he takes on Horn and discovers that Horn has hired the man he was looking for all along.

programme.title: Desolation Canyon
programme.desc: Western about a sheriff ('Dallas' star, Patrick Duffy) who persuades his old friend (Stacy Keach, 'Prison Break'), a retired gunslinger, to join himin pursuit of a notorious gang. The band of outlaws counts the gunslinger's son as one of its members.

programme.title: Sacricfies of the Heart
programme.desc: Emotional family drama. A hotshot city lawyer (Melissa Gilbert, ʻLittle House on the Prairieʼ) returns to the family farm run by her older brother and her estranged father, who is suffering from Alzheimerʼs disease. As his health and memory deteriorate, she reaches a new understanding about what drove her mother to commit suicide.

programme.title: I Do (But I Don't)
programme.desc: Denise Richards plays Lauren, a divorced wedding-planner who falls for the groom-to-be (Dean Cain).

programme.title: The Reading Room
programme.desc: Fulfilling his beloved wife's dying wish, William Campbell restores an abandoned building they own into a reading room for a depressed community notorious for its ineffectual high school and street gangs.

programme.title: Word of Honor
programme.desc: A corporate exec and family man is accused of participating in a war crime 30 years earlier during the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Disenfranchised by economic catastrophe & the fall of a nation, destitute young women & children are left behind and become prey to the underworld. They are a desirable commodity in a billion dollar industry where human beings are bought and sold. In the Ukraine, sixteen-year-old Nadia (Laurence Leboeuf, The Secret) is seduced by the promises of a modeling agency. She runs away from home and disappears. In Southeast Asia, the vacation of a middle-class American couple turns into a nightmare when their twelve-year-old daughter, Annie (Sarah-Jeanne Labrosse, 15/Love), is kidnapped and sold to a brothel. In Prague, Helena (Isabelle Blais, The Barbarian Invasions), a struggling single mother is swept off her feet by the advances of a wealthy businessman. But it's a trap and she too "disappears". In Romania, an orphaned seventeen year old Katerina (Anna Hopkins,Thunderstone) vanishes after meeting her fiancé, whom she met online. The horrific destiny of each victim is tied to a sex-trafficking ring. It's the job of Kate Morozov (Oscar and Golden Globe winner Mira Sorvino, Mighty Aphrodite), a detective for Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) to help find the men responsible. But first she knows she must win the faith of the victims who have learned firsthand the futility of trust. While Annie's parents join forces with Tom Halloran (Terry Haig, The Aviator) and a renegade worker for an NGO, scouting a child-prostitution ring, Nadia's grief-stricken father Viktor is embarking on his own personal hunt to find the men responsible. From a torture chamber in the suburbs of Queens to the flesh-peddlers of Russia the hunt is on, revealing a shocking conspiracy of global proportions. Featuring Emmy and Golden Globe winner Donald Sutherland, (The Italian Job) and Robert Carlyle (The Full Monty) Human Trafficking is at once a gripping government procedural, a cautionary tale of an international scourge, and one of the most compulsively important thrillers of the ye.

programme.title: Human Trafficking
programme.desc: Human Trafficking is an American crime drama series dealing with the terrible crime of selling people into the sex slave industry. The series follows an American agent, Kate Morozov, as she goes undercover to investigate the cases of dead prostitutes suspecting they are victims of trafficking. Meanwhile, three young women from different parts of the world are forced to become sex workers, as part of the international network led by Sergei Karpovich. Helena, a single mother from Prague has a chance to testify.

programme.desc: TVmovie about a widowed police officer and his rebellious teenage daughter who move from Los Angeles to the wilds of Montana. Awed by the beauty of the countryside but dismayed by the lack of urban amenities, the pair struggle to adapt to their new ranching lifestyle.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 5: Game Time
programme.desc: Bright youngest graduate Randy (Stinky) Lawrence convinces Samantha to promote his brilliant murder video game in the bookstore in exchange for his help in convincing "old friend" Donald Fiske, a celebrated author, to do a signing session there. To Randy's surprise, it works, but Fiske is poisoned after slipping out angry. Randy is Chief Connors's only suspect. Despite obvious repeated lies, Samantha sets out to prove his innocence. Fiske's greedy ex, Jody, pretends to have convinced him to remarry, yet she never even allowed their teenage son Cameron to set foot in Donald's fine home.

programme.title: Mystery Woman - At First Sight
programme.desc: After dating hot doctor Ben, "Mystery Woman" Samantha becomes curious about her family medical history so she sets out upstate to fictitious small town; Whiptail, California in search of her birth mother. Samantha finds her unfortunately she has just been arrested as a suspect in a murder. Murder and mystery follow Samantha wherever she goes.

programme.desc: Addictive series following New Zealand's Public Health Officers. A visit to a Chinese restaurant with a history of problems, plus a major rat infestation in one building.

programme.desc: Nick's plan to let fate bring his wife to him must be altered, because he must replace his father as Santa Claus on December 26. Ernst, the right-hand man to several generations of Santas, generates a list of potential mates. Nick dutifully sets off to meet them, but fate may have a candidate after all.

programme.title: Love is a Four Letter Word
programme.desc: Margaret and Martin Harper, both sixty years old, are filing for divorce, but plan to keep everything as civilized as possible. programme.desc: Bobby Hattaway (Lou Diamond Phillips), an honored soldier, returns home after the American Civil War to find his father's (Stacy Keach) formerly prosperous store now dangerously in debt to the town's ruthless leader, and Bobby's childhood friend, Stu Croker (Vincent Spano). Bobby will now face off against his former friend to take control from Stu.

programme.title: Mystery Woman 8: Wild West Mystery
programme.desc: Former Red River TV series star Clint Lawson's Wild West show is in town, the prize act in the annual festival, which the sponsoring bookshop is presiding over. He strains a leg due to a sabotaged saddle strap. His stand-in, Dogie, is fatally shot while starring in his place, so who was the intended target? Evidence seems to pile up against Clint, so the chief simply jails him without further investigation. However, the bookshop sleuths team digs up dirty secrets from their past and that of other show cast, such as ex-con announcer Jeb Fletcher, Clint's ex-lover Annie whom he promised a movie part like Strother Elam, and Zeke Foster, who secretly deals in illegitimate Red River memorabilia.

From Sydney's rise to become a million-dollar, modern-day madam to her notorious plummet into bankruptcy and public disgrace, experience a private glimpse into the forbidden world of high-class prostitution-where money talks...pleasure sells...and discretion is everything.

programme.title: Ambulance Girl
programme.desc: Comedy drama directed by and starring Kathy Bates. When paralysing phobias threaten the personal and professional life of a food writer (Bates), she decides to venture off in a completely different direction. As a volunteer paramedic, she finally discovers the perfect way to help herself by helping others.

programme.title: Redeemer
programme.desc: A writer is touched by the story of a former Black Panther who seams to have been wrongfully convicted to life imprisonment 20 years ago. The writer decides to try to help the now middle-aged convict get exonerated.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: Drama. A woman moves with her seven-year-old daughter and husband to California from Colorado. After her husband abandons them, she tries to rebuild their lives. Finding solace caring for horses, she decides to enter a horse show.

programme.title: Out of the Ashes
programme.desc: A Holocaust survivor heads for America where she dreams of starting a new life, but finds it difficult to put the past behind her, especially when she's forced to relive the nightmare of Auschwitz.

programme.title: To The Ends of The Earth

programme.title: Murder Among Friends
programme.desc: Isabella Delarocca is a young Italian who moves to Hollywood determined to succeed as an actress. Isabella begins to teach theater classes and when a colleague of hers is arrested for murder, she decides to investigate on her behalf because she does not believe that he is guilty.

programme.title: Arthur Hailey's: Detective
programme.desc: Detective Sergeant Malcolm Ainslie, a Catholic priest turned distinguished investigator for the police, has agreed to hear the confession of a convicted serial killer sentenced to death in a just a matter of hours. What he promises to reveal to Ainslie is the truth behind the crimes and the reason he confessed to the one crime Ainslie doesn't even believe he committed. What unfolds between the two men is a serpentine trail into both men's pasts based on the bestseller from master storyteller Arthur Hailey.

programme.title: Andalūzijos turas. La Roda de Andalucia - Lucena (167,6 km)
programme.desc: The Andalucia Bike Race is Spain's premier mountain bike race, and one of the most outstanding in the world as recognized by the Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI). Incorporating six stages over six days, the race weaves its way up and down the Andalucia mountains at a blistering pace, routing through spectacular trails and sensational views. Elite and masters race categories offer individual and team leader board standings, with daily stage prizes, overall medals and prize money for the elite UCI riders. The pace of the competition never slows across the six stages, kicking off with the stage 1 time trial; a short, fast and intense 'flash stage', featuring single tracks mixed with overtaking sections. Five days, 32 kilometres and over 6,590 meters of ascent later, the 57.8km "finisher" stage 6 is the final test, as riders climb over 1,396 meters up the mythical Reventón and pass through Trasierra, before descending and finishing along Santo Domingo's unforgettable single-track trail. Riders choose their risks to secure an advantage, all the time fully conscious that one mistake navigating the rocky trails means their race is over. Winning this 9th edition of the Andalucia Bike Race, were Spain's David Valero in the men's elite, with Hildegunn Hovdenak of Norway tacking victory in the women's elite.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Žalgiris" - "Olympiacos"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Fenerbahce" - "Partizan"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Brand new series. Savute, Botswana: 2000 square miles of remote African savannah. This ancient land is governed by competing clans of ruthlessly proficient predators - leopards, lions, hyenas and wild dogs. Their survival depends on the giant herds of powerful prey - buffalo, elephant and zebra - who have roamed Savute in search of sustenance, season after season, millennium after millennium. Each day is a life-or-death struggle - animal against animal, animal against nature. There is no mercy, and there is but one rule: survive. In this episode, a small family of wild dogs goes on the run, desperately looking for a safe place to raise six tiny puppies. But the Savage Kingdom will test them to the limit. Narrated by Charles Dance.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: As the Arctic changes faster than ever, a team of polar bear guides prepares for an epic journey; a first-ever attempt to follow the bears on the sea ice of Hudson Bay. In this high-stakes high-reward venture, they will document the secret world of bears, a mysterious and disappearing realm that is the bears key to survival. Life on the ice is a critical time for these bears. It also remains undocumented, deemed too dangerous for humans to follow, hinted at only through aerial reconnaissance and satellite collar research. The team, armed with traditional ecological knowledge and the latest 4K camera technology, will witness never- before-seen seal hunting strategies and document rapid adaptations to climate change, including whale predation and open-water hunting.

Polar species have evolved bodies and behaviours that help them combat the intense hostility of their habitats. But now, their world is changing so fast - literally breaking apart under their feet - and their resilience will be tested beyond the extreme.

programme.title: World's Creepiest Killers

programme.title: Dead By Dawn: Compilation
programme.desc: In Indonesia, a bat struggles to climb past a vanguard of vipers to reach the safety of her colony. In Southern India, a mother bandicoot rat must outswim a cobra and crocodiles to find food for her babies. And in the rainforests of Costa Rica, darkness means a deadly free-for-all. Who will survive the horrors of night long enough to see the day, and who will be dead by dawn?

programme.title: Dead By Dawn: Compilation
programme.desc: In the Arabian Desert, a gecko realizes he's not alone when the sand beneath his feet starts shifting. Who will survive the horrors of tonight, and who will be dead by dawn?

programme.title: Land of the Iberian Lynx
programme.desc: Sierra Morena is a mountain range of climatic extremes. The harsh winter puts the lynxes of the Jandula River Valley to the test. Golden eagles, otters, wild boars and cormorants struggle to survive in the land of the Iberian lynx.

programme.title: Europe's New Wild
programme.desc: This stunning six-part nature series tells the inspiring story of the rebirthing of the wild regions of the continent of Europe. A land formerly full of diverse wildlife and contrasting landscapes, Europe was in need of special rewilding teams to embark on a mission to return species to their natural habitat and this series focuses on six regions that have benefitted from the project. The Carpathian Mountains of Romania have seen the reintroduction of European bison while rural depopulation in Spain and Portugal offers up the opportunity to expand the wild nature of the Iberian Peninsula. The teams also look at how bears and humans can live peacefully, side by side and explores the myriad creatures that call the Danube Delta home. The unique culture and atmosphere of Lapland plays host to distinctive wildlife and the Sámi people and a natural balance is being restored to the Balkans.

programme.title: Polar Worlds with Bertie Gregory Mashup
programme.desc: The North and South poles - one force determines everything for the animals who call these regions home: water. Wildlife filmmaker Bertie Gregory travels towards both extremes of the Earth to find the creatures who have mastered surviving in the icy waters of some of the planet's harshest landscapes.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. programme.title: Killer Animal Tactics
programme.desc: From top predators to clever creatures, these killers are some of the most armed and dangerous animals in the world. In order to survive, they use some of the scariest strategies and lethal weapons like ambush, camouflage, claws and paws, venom, pack hunting and more to take down prey. The name of the game is kill or be killed!

programme.title: Snow Leopard of Afghanistan
programme.desc: Scientists try to catch and notice one of the most beautiful big cats. However they must go to war zones for that.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild
programme.desc: Watch a range of wild animals trying to survive in the wilderness as they migrate, hunt and defend themselves against predators and the dangers that are living alongside them. Follow animals born to fight to those designed to live in the canopy of trees as the series gives you an insight into natures greatest spectacles from around the world on land, water and air. This nature documentary is intriguing and engaging as they examine a range of species and how they survive in the most brutal environments.

programme.title: Trials of the Wild

programme.title: Kingdom of the White Wolf
programme.desc: Join Ronan Donovan, a National Geographic Explorer and photographer, as he takes the viewer on a unique adventure to track down the hard-to-find Arctic wolf. The series follows the year-long travails of a family of Arctic wolves on Ellesmere Island, from the first breaking light after the long winter, through the life-bringing springtime, the fattening summer months and the preparations of autumn. Each episode deals with different obstacles that the wolves face and have to overcome and, along the way, we the various characters and personalities of the animal family are revealed. The show makes good use of intimate footage to make the viewer feel that they are actually there, observing the creatures up close.

programme.title: Freaks & Creep
programme.desc: Lucy Cooke is on a one-woman mission to show why the ugly, weird and overlooked animals of the world can be cute, cuddly and deserving of attention. Join her as she heads off to the rainforests of Borneo. Borneo is its own very unique crucible of weirdness - with countless strange creatures that can only be found there. Lucy's goal is get up close with the giant-nosed proboscis monkey to figure out why this creature looks so strange. Along the way, she finds many other "odd ones" - animals that have come up with all kinds of strange adaptations so they can survive in the forest of Borneo. Lucy finds dung beetles in action - eating dung; frogs that fly; a tarsier, with eyes that are bigger than its brain; and the wooly bat that makes its home is a carnivorous plant.

programme.title: Dr Oakley: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Spanning thousands of acres and incorporating hundreds of species of animals; Michelle Oakley's veterinary practice is Yukon tough. There is no such thing as a typical day in Michelle's practice. House calls can range from expelling dogs anal glands to getting chased down by the very large Arctic musk-ox. Accompanied by her teenage daughters and armed with humor as sharp as scalpel, Michelle deftly juggles being a full time Veterinarian, wife and doctor; taking us into unexplored and unexamined regions of the Yukon.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.desc: On a fairy family trip to Fairy World, Dev convinces Hazel to steal Peri's wand and explore Fairy World. Together they must battle the dragon and find their way back to their fairies before Jorgen finds out! // When band and orchestra tryouts happen at school, Hazel finds herself stuck in the middle of a rivalry between the two. Rather than choose a side, she wishes to be good at all instruments and ends up in both. Exhausted from the double life she's living, she wishes that the band and orchestra had nothing to be rivals about. In granting the wish, Cosmo and Wanda get rid of all music on Earth. Hazel, with the help of the Nmusic Phairy (silent N), must restore music to Earth and end this rivalry once and for all!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: During a visit from Antony, Hazel's wish lands them inside "Rattleconda Racers," a board game they invented. Once in the game, however, they bicker about the best way to play. Hazel wants to stick to the rules they used to play by, but Antony wants to make new ones. When the formidable Rhonda the Rattleconda takes off with Cosmo and Wanda, intending to make them her next meal, Hazel and Antony must confront the tension in their relationship to save them and escape the game! // When Hazel must give a presentation on what she wants to be when she grows up, she is excited to share her dreams of being a geologist! Wanting to wow her classmates, she wishes she could excavate an "out of this world" rock to show them. Cosmo and Wanda poof her underground to find a super special rock, and she does! But in the process, she angers a group of rock monsters and must use her knowledge of geology to win them over, get her rock back, and escape the cave!

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents: A New Wish
programme.desc: Dev is bummed at his own birthday party because his dad is off working. Hazel tries to cheer him up by wishing for a pair of rocket boots for him. He is stoked! Then, a party princess arrives, but this is no ordinary party princess, it's VICKY from the original series. Meanwhile, Cosmo, Wanda, and Peri stumble into a secret room, where they discover that Dale has been investigating Hazel since Founder's Day. Back at the party, Vicky, rotten as ever, forces the kids to make crafts for her online store instead of having fun. Hazel comes up with a plan full of zany traps to stop Vicky and take the party back! When Dev discovers his dad has been researching Hazel instead of spending time with him, Dev lashes out at Hazel and wishes Peri away. Left alone with his anger, is there a devious plan hatching in Dev's mind?

programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Mental Hen: Kowalski has a rival, if you even can call it a rivalry. A Delaware Blue Hen has taken up residence at the zoo, and she has the amazing ability to predict the future! Kowalski doesn't buy the psychic chicken hype and sets out to discredit her. The truth turns out to be far more sinister than a simple sports-pickin' chicken, and Kowalski will have to use all his best moves to wiggle out of this mess. Thumb Drive: The penguins need a thumb, and Maurice's fits the bill nicely. Using the opposable digit thumbprint to break into a secret weapons lab gets the penguins all atwitter. King Julien is unhappy that his right hand man is running around on missions with the birds so he sets out to sabotage the mission. As with most of King Julien's plans, this scheme turns out to be "thumbs down"!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Antics on Ice: Private's in heaven - icy, freezing heaven. The Lunacorns on Ice extravaganza is in town, and Skipper's determined to take him as a treat. Accompanied by unexpected fellow fanboys Bing and Roy, the gang heads to the arena. Things get a bit d-icey when the gorilla and rhino end up on the ice with the lunacorns. The enraged director is ready to shutter the whole thing unless they find some way to slip 'n slide out of it. Showdown on Fairway 18:A legendary putter is at the center of controversy when the Amarillo Kid returns to the zoo. The slippery armadillo needs Private's help to make good on an ill-advised bet with two gopher brothers. Who's the bad guy here though? The gophers show up at the zoo to actually warn the penguins about the kid! The story takes us on more twists and turns than a Pebble Beach golf hole!

With the fate of Fairy World on her shoulders, Hazel enlists the help of Jasmine, Winn, Antony, and a few magical friends from past wishes, to rise up against Dev and his anti-fairy forces. Hazel must save Cosmo, Wanda, Peri, and Fairy World, before making a very special rule-free wish.

programme.desc: Littlefoot: Marlene is dying to go see a concert in the park. But, every time she leaves the zoo she becomes a feral monster! Kowalski comes to the rescue with his invention the Persona-Disentangleizer, which separates her savage nature from her regular self. The savage Marlene escapes and rampages through the city. Can the Penguins stop her before she destroys the city? Smotherly Love: Ma, an empty-nested mother possum, takes up residence in the Penguins Lair after they destroy her home during a battle with Hans the Puffin. She smothers the penguins with love and nurturing, and gets her new boys to behave by playing possum whenever necessary. The battle-hardened unit devolves into a bunch of softies, opening the door for Hans to take advantage. It looks like he has the upper wing, unless someone can make a play to stop him!

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: A Kipper for Skipper: It's off to the races when Skipper agrees to give a day off from hard training to the first penguin who can bring him a kipper. Private, Rico, and Kowalski battle their way to a fish packing plant where they discover Officer X has become Fishmonger X. The deranged X sniffs out the fighting penguins, capturing them and hauling them off to the pokey. Can they rediscover the teamwork they had forsaken in order to escape? High Moltage: The penguins are determined to make opening day of their favorite action star's blockbuster movie! Private, however, has an itchy problem - he's turned hideous because he's molting! The penguins need his hypercute powers to knock Alice out and disengage her new zoo security system. The despondent bird does all he can to reconstruct his cuteness, but sadly his hypercute powers distort to cause a hyperalarming, hypervomitous mess!

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.title: Football: LaLiga
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: Adam Driver nel fanta-action prodotto da Sam Raimi. Quando un'astronave precipita su un pianeta sconosciuto, due superstiti scoprono di trovarsi sulla Terra di 65 milioni di anni fa.

programme.title: Robin Hood - L'origine della leggenda
programme.desc: Tornato in Inghilterra, Robin di Loxley scopre che il malvagio sceriffo di Nottingham ha preso possesso delle sue proprietà. L'uomo si unisce a una banda di ribelli, in un piano audace per rubare allo sceriffo i suoi soldi e togliergli il potere.

programme.title: The Life of Chuck
programme.desc: Dalla penna di Stephen King, un emozionante inno alla vita diretto da Mike Flanagan. La straordinaria vita dell'uomo comune Charles Krantz (Tom Hiddleston) raccontata a ritroso.

programme.title: The Equalizer - Il vendicatore
programme.desc: Denzel Washington in un action ispirato alla serie anni '80 "Un giustiziere a New York". Un ex federale torna ad affrontare il crimine per salvare una giovane prostituta.

programme.title: I morti non soffrono
programme.desc: Negli anni 1860, la francocanadese vivace e indipendente Vivienne Le Coudy intraprende un viaggio con l'immigrato danese Holger Olsen, cercando di costruire una vita insieme nella polverosa città di Elk Flats, Nevada.

programme.title: Allied - Un'ombra nascosta
programme.desc: Il sapore del cinema classico in un'impeccabile spy-story sull'arte dell'inganno con Brad Pitt e Marion Cotillard, diretti da Robert Zemeckis. 1942: l'ufficiale franco-canadese Max Vatan e la militante della Resistenza francese Marianne Beausejour si innamorano dopo aver compiuto una missione: l'uccisione dell'ambasciatore tedesco a Casablanca. L'armonia della loro love story viene però incrinata dal sospetto: Max Vatan viene infatti informato dai suoi superiori che Marianne potrebbe essere una spia al soldo dei nazisti. Dallo sceneggiatore de "La promessa dell'assassino", Steven Knight.

programme.title: Il miglio verde
programme.desc: Tom Hanks nel dramma carcerario tratto dal romanzo di Stephen King. 1935: un gigantesco uomo di colore, dotato di poteri curativi, viene condannato a morte per omicidio.

programme.title: Diamanti
programme.desc: Ferzan Ozpetek firma il suo maggior successo con un maestoso cast al femminile. Un regista convoca le sue attrici preferite: vuole fare un film sulle donne ma non svela altro.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: 6 Oscar a una commedia cult degli anni 90, con Tom Hanks per la regia di Robert Zemeckis. Le incredibili vicende di un uomo ingenuo ma ottimista sullo sfondo di 30 anni di storia americana.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Il signore delle mosche
programme.desc: Un gruppo di ragazzi sopravvive a un incidente aereo e tenta di organizzarsi su un'isola tropicale. Tra loro c'è il giovane Piggy che, insieme a Raph, prova a radunare i dispersi.

programme.title: Il signore delle mosche
programme.desc: Nel gruppo di ragazzi affiorano le prime fratture e l'ambizioso Jack, rompendo con Ralph e promettendo divertimento e caccia, decide di formare una tribù autonoma separata.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: I paesaggi incontaminati dell'Alaska, le musiche di Eddie Vedder (Golden Globe per la miglior canzone originale, "Guaranteed') e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Dopo essersi laureato con il massimo dei voti, appena diciottenne, il giovane Christopher McCandless lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un lungo viaggio impervio e intimo a contatto con la natura. Solo, senza soldi o altre risorse, in un lungo cammino attraverso gli Stati Uniti, scandito da numerosi incontri, fino ad arrivare nella selvaggia Alaska.

programme.title: Eiffel
programme.desc: Appassionante Sky Original con Romain Duris ed Emma Mackey. Parigi, 1889: l'incontro con una donna amata in passato ispira Gustave Eiffel nella costruzione della celebre torre.

programme.title: The Alto Knights - I due volti del crimine
programme.desc: Barry Levinson dirige Robert De Niro in un thriller dallo sceneggiatore di "Quei bravi ragazzi". New York, anni 50: per ottenere il controllo del mondo malavitoso, il boss Vito Genovese ordina di uccidere il rivale Frank Costello, che sopravvive miracolosamente all'attentato.

programme.title: Prova a prendermi
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio e Tom Hanks in un biopic diretto da Steven Spielberg. La vera storia di Frank Abagnale, geniale truffatore sulle cui tracce si mette un caparbio agente dell'FBI.

programme.title: Michael Collins
programme.desc: Leone d’oro a Venezia 1996 per il regista Neil Jordan e Coppa Volpi a Liam Neeson, leader guerrigliero nell'Irlanda lacerata e insanguinata dalle lotte del movimento indipendentista. Uscito di prigione dove era stato rinchiuso in seguito agli scontri armati di Dublino del 1916, Collins continua la sua lotta contro il dominio britannico, riuscendo a fare proseliti grazie al suo carisma. Intanto insieme a un gruppo di militanti, organizza attacchi e azioni di sabotaggio contro il governo che non esiterà a usare anche mezzi poco leciti per intimidirlo.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Ron Howard dirige Chris Hemsworth e Daniel Bruhl nel biopic sulla rivalita' fra i piloti James Hunt e Niki Lauda, protagonisti di una memorabile stagione della Formula Uno.

programme.title: Apollo 13
programme.desc: 2 Oscar alla pellicola di Ron Howard con Tom Hanks sulla sfortunata missione spaziale. 1970: il viaggio verso la Luna della navicella Apollo 13 viene interrotto da un'esplosione.

programme.title: Into the Wild - Nelle terre selvagge
programme.desc: I paesaggi incontaminati dell'Alaska, le musiche di Eddie Vedder (Golden Globe per la miglior canzone originale, "Guaranteed') e la regia di Sean Penn per un film che celebra la ricerca della liberta'. Dopo essersi laureato con il massimo dei voti, appena diciottenne, il giovane Christopher McCandless lascia agi e vincoli familiari per un lungo viaggio impervio e intimo a contatto con la natura. Solo, senza soldi o altre risorse, in un lungo cammino attraverso gli Stati Uniti, scandito da numerosi incontri, fino ad arrivare nella selvaggia Alaska.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al War Movie di Christopher Nolan che ripercorre la storica Operazione Dynamo. 1940: la difesa degli inglesi, attaccati dai nazisti, viene narrata da un triplice punto di vista.

programme.title: Quasi amici
programme.desc: Omar Sy e François Cluzet nella commedia campione d'incassi. Un miliardario paralizzato stringe una grande amicizia con il suo badante: un ragazzo senegalese appena uscito dal carcere.

programme.title: Pulp fiction
programme.desc: 1 Oscar, 1 Golden Globe e Palma d'oro a Cannes per il film-simbolo di Quentin Tarantino con John Travolta, Uma Thurman e Bruce Willis in un intreccio di scene cult e personaggi stravaganti.

programme.title: Nel nome del padre
programme.desc: Biopic con Daniel Day-Lewis ed Emma Thompson diretti da Jim Sheridan, Orso d'oro a Berlino. La drammatica vicenda giudiziaria di 4 irlandesi condannati ingiustamente per terrorismo.

programme.title: Il Padrino: Epilogo - La morte di Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia, restaurato e rimontato da Francis Ford Coppola. Il sessantenne Mike Corleone individua in Vincent il successore del suo impero criminale.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: 3 Oscar al War Movie di Christopher Nolan che ripercorre la storica Operazione Dynamo. 1940: la difesa degli inglesi, attaccati dai nazisti, viene narrata da un triplice punto di vista.

programme.title: The Brutalist
programme.desc: 3 Oscar, 3 Golden Globe e Leone d'argento alla regia di Brady Corbet che dirige Adrien Brody, Felicity Jones e Guy Pearce. Un architetto ebreo e sua moglie, sopravvissuti all'Olocausto, lasciano l'Ungheria per emigrare negli Stati Uniti. Un facoltoso cliente cambierà le loro vite.

programme.title: Resistance
programme.desc: Jesse Eisenberg, Ed Harris e Clemence Poesy nel biopic su Marcel Marceau. Nella Francia occupata dai nazisti, il mimo si unisce alla Resistenza per salvare centinaia di bambini ebrei.

programme.title: Il grande Lebowski
programme.desc: Commedia cult del Fratelli Coen con Jeff Bridges, John Goodman e Steve Buscemi. Drugo, un ex hippie omonimo di un ricco magnate, deve risolvere il caso di un misterioso rapimento.

programme.title: Zero Dark Thirty
programme.desc: 1 Oscar per il thriller di Kathryn Bigelow con Joel Edgerton e Jessica Chastain, premiata ai Golden Globe. Un team della Cia collabora con i Navy Seals per catturare Osama Bin Laden.

programme.title: Margin Call
programme.desc: Kevin Spacey, Paul Bettany e Jeremy Irons in un thriller ambientato a Wall Street. All'alba della crisi finanziaria, un gruppo di manager ha 24 ore per evitare il fallimento di una banca.

programme.title: Il paziente inglese
programme.desc: 9 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe all’intenso dramma con Ralph Fiennes, Juliette Binoche e Willem Dafoe. Toscana, 2a guerra mondiale: un'infermiera accudisce un uomo che nasconde un tragico segreto.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per Spike Lee e Oscar alla sceneggiatura. Un poliziotto afroamericano si infiltra nel Ku Klux Klan per indagare sul razzismo nell'America degli anni 70.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: Fuori
programme.desc: Valeria Golino, Elodie e Matilda De Angelis, premiate con il Nastro d'Argento, nel film di Mario Martone dal romanzo autobiografico di Goliarda Sapienza. 1980: in carcere, la scrittrice instaura un legame di sorellanza con due detenute che continua quando le donne ritrovano la libertà.

programme.title: The Young Messiah
programme.desc: Dal romanzo di Anne Rice, una pellicola che ripercorre l'infanzia di Gesu'. A 7 anni il futuro Messia lascia l'Egitto per tornare a Nazareth dove scopre le sue vere origini.

programme.title: C'era una volta il West
programme.desc: Henry Fonda e Claudia Cardinale nel western che ha consacrato il mito di Sergio Leone. Un magnate delle ferrovie ingaggia un killer per impadronirsi del terreno di un'ex prostituta.

programme.title: BlacKkKlansman
programme.desc: Gran Premio della Giuria a Cannes per Spike Lee e Oscar alla sceneggiatura. Un poliziotto afroamericano si infiltra nel Ku Klux Klan per indagare sul razzismo nell'America degli anni 70.

programme.title: Siccita'
programme.desc: 2 David di Donatello al film di Paolo Virzi' con un grande cast corale. In una Roma in cui non piove da tre anni, fra divieti e disagi, si incrociano i destini di un gruppo di individui.

programme.title: Saint Judy
programme.desc: Michelle Monaghan nella vera storia di Judy Wood, l'avvocato che ha cambiato la legge sul diritto d'asilo negli Usa. Assunta in uno studio di Los Angeles, si batte per una donna afgana.

programme.title: Will Hunting - Genio ribelle
programme.desc: Oscar a Robin Williams e alla sceneggiatura per il capolavoro di Gus Van Sant con Matt Damon e Ben Affleck. Un genio allo sbando incontra uno psicologo. La sua vita cambierà per sempre.

programme.title: First Man - Il primo uomo
programme.desc: Ryan Gosling e' Neil Armstrong nel biopic di Damien Chazelle premiato con 1 Oscar e 1 Golden Globe. America, anni 60: la storia della missione spaziale che porto' alla conquista della Luna.

programme.title: Civil War
programme.desc: Negli Stati Uniti infuocati da una sanguinosa guerra civile, Kirsten Dunst è la coraggiosa fotografa Lee che, insieme ad una collega e due giornalisti, intraprende un rischioso viaggio da New York a Washington per intervistare il Presidente.

programme.title: Elisa
programme.desc: Un criminologo segue il caso di Elisa, una donna di 35 anni rinchiusa in prigione da 10 anni per il barbaro omicidio apparentemente immotivato della sorella e per averne bruciato il cadavere. Sostiene di ricordare poco o niente del delitto.

programme.title: Southpaw - L'ultima sfida
programme.desc: Avvincente dramma sul mondo della boxe con Jack Gyllenhaal e Rachel McAdams. Caduto in disgrazia dopo un incidente, un pugile deve tornare sul ring per ottenere la custodia della figlia.

programme.title: Per un pugno di dollari
programme.desc: Sergio Leone dirige Clint Eastwood nel primo capitolo restaurato della trilogia del dollaro. Un pistolero risolve la lotta tra due famiglie di contrabbandieri.

programme.title: Per qualche dollaro in piu'
programme.desc: Secondo capitolo restaurato della trilogia western di Sergio Leone con Clint Eastwood e Gian Maria Volontè. Due pistoleri braccano un bandito messicano sul quale pende una grossa taglia.

programme.title: Bad Boys II
programme.desc: Will Smith e Martin Lawrence tornano in azione in un travolgente sequel diretto da Michael Bay. I due detective della Squadra Narcotici di Miami devono fermare un traffico di ecstasy.

programme.title: Bad Boys for Life
programme.desc: Azione e nostalgia nel terzo capitolo della saga con Will Smith e Martin Lawrence. I detective Lowrey e Burnett fanno di nuovo squadra per fermare la killer di un cartello messicano, evasa dal carcere con l’obiettivo di vendicarsi dei responsabili del suo arresto.

programme.title: Bad Boys: Ride or Die
programme.desc: I due poliziotti di Miami, incastrati dalle mele marce del dipartimento, devono sfuggire dai colleghi e dai narcotrafficanti. Per risolvere la sporca faccenda agiranno per conto proprio e fuori dai limiti consentiti dalla legge.

programme.title: Drive Hard
programme.desc: John Cusack e Thomas Jane ("Hung - Ragazzo squillo") in uno sfrenato action ad altissima velocita'. Simon Keller, un famoso ladro americano, ha bisogno di un autista per mettersi in salvo dopo una rapina in banca. Alla fine la scelta cade su Peter Roberts, un ex pilota di Formula Uno, all'oscuro dei piani del criminale. Keller lo assume come istruttore e mette a segno il colpo proprio durante una delle lezioni di guida. Cosi' Roberts si ritrova con le spalle al muro: costretto a usare tutta la sua abilita' per sfuggire alla polizia.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: Fanta-action di Roland Emmerich con Halle Berry e Patrick Wilson. Due astronauti e un complottista devono evitare che la Luna precipiti sulla Terra a causa di una forza misteriosa.

programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Keanu Reeves in un action spettacolare. Attratto dalla possibilita' di soldi facili, un talento del tai chi entra nel mondo dei combattimenti illegali.

programme.desc: Quarto capitolo della saga con il ritorno di Vin Diesel, Paul Walker e Michelle Rodriguez. Dominic Toretto torna a Los Angeles per vendicare un'amica e ritrova l'agente O'Conner.

programme.desc: Sesto capitolo della saga action con Vin Diesel, Paul Walker, 'The Rock' e Michelle Rodriguez. Dominic e Brian riuniscono la vecchia squadra per contrastare una banda di piloti criminali.

programme.desc: Vin Diesel, 'The Rock', Jason Statham e il compianto Paul Walker nel settimo capitolo della saga. Dominic e compagni devono difendersi da un killer deciso a vendicare il fratello.

Cecilia e' sposata con Adrian Griffin, uno scienziato tanto brillante quanto psicopatico e maniaco del controllo. Una relazione tossica da cui la donna finalmente riesce a fuggire. Ma Cecilia si sente ancora perseguitata e sospetta che il vendicativo e geniale consorte sia una presenza invisibile nella sua vita. A ragione, Griffin ha elaborato un subdolo piano per tornare a terrorizzarla. Scritto e diretto da Leigh Whannell, sceneggiatore di alcuni capitoli della saga di "Saw - L'enigmista'.

programme.desc: La vita perfetta di una donna viene sconvolta dal ritorno di un'ombra malevola del suo passato, che la costringe a confrontarsi con il mostro che ha eluso per due decenni della sua vita.

programme.title: Modalita' aereo
programme.desc: Lillo e Paolo Ruffini in una commedia di Fausto Brizzi. Due inservienti dell'aeroporto si impossessano del cellulare di un ricco imprenditore e si vendicano della sua arroganza.

programme.title: I migliori giorni
programme.desc: Massimiliano Bruno ed Edoardo Leo registi e interpreti di una commedia con un grande cast in 4 episodi, ognuno dedicato a una festività fra disagi, vendette e tradimenti.

programme.title: CHiPS
programme.desc: Dax Shepard, Michael Pena e un cameo di Erik Estrada nella commedia ispirata alla serie tv anni 80. Per indagare su un giro di corruzione, un agente Fbi lavorerà con una recluta.

programme.title: Io & Marilyn
programme.desc: Durante una seduta spiritica Gualtiero evoca lo spirito di Marylin Monroe. L'attrice diventa una preziosa amica che lo aiuta a riconquistare sua moglie, scappata con un domatore di leoni.

programme.title: Scemo e più scemo
programme.desc: Jim Carrey e Jeff Daniels nel celebre road movie demenziale firmato dai fratelli Farrelly. Due amici svitati ne combinano di tutti i colori per restituire una valigetta a una donna.

programme.title: (Im)perfetti criminali
programme.desc: Action-comedy Sky Original di Alessio Maria Federici. Quattro guardie giurate progettano un colpo grosso in gioielleria per aiutare uno di loro. Non mancheranno sorprese e colpi di scena.

programme.title: Indovina chi viene a Natale?
programme.desc: Commedia natalizia di Fausto Brizzi con Diego Abatantuono e Claudio Bisio. Una famiglia allargata si riunisce per le feste in una località di montagna, scatenando equivoci e incomprensioni.

programme.title: Contromano
programme.desc: Graffiante commedia di e con Antonio Albanese. Un commerciante milanese escogita un piano per liberarsi di un venditore ambulante senegalese che gli sta facendo concorrenza.

programme.title: Il vegetale
programme.desc: Gennaro Nunziante ('Quo Vado?) dirige Fabio Rovazzi in una commedia sui nostri tempi. Alla ricerca del primo impiego, un ambizioso neolaureato affronta una serie di comiche vicissitudini.

programme.title: Il pataffio
programme.desc: Commedia ambientata nel Medioevo con Lino Musella, Giorgio Tirabassi, Alessandro Gassmann e Valerio Mastandrea. Un nobile scopre che il suo feudo e' in rovina e abitato da paesani affamati.

programme.title: I pompieri
programme.desc: Lino Banfi e Massimo Boldi fra incendi e allagamenti, in un mare di risate. Due vigili del fuoco in pensione ritornano in servizio unendosi ai colleghi più giovani della disastrosa squadra 17, il cui caposquadra è affetto da sonnambulismo. Oltre ai guai in cui finiscono ogni volta che affrontano una missione, questi goffi pompieri dovranno vedersela con lo zelante comandante della caserma e con un fastidioso giornalista alla ricerca continua di scoop. Cast arricchito da Christian De Sica, Gigi Sammarchi, Andrea Roncato e da un cameo di Moana Pozzi.

programme.title: Belli ciao
programme.desc: Il duo comico di successo Pio e Amedeo nella commedia diretta da Gennaro Nunziante. Due amici d'infanzia, separati da scelte diverse, si ritrovano dopo anni fra differenze e sogni in comune.

programme.title: Febbre da cavallo - La mandrakata
programme.desc: Carlo Vanzina dirige Gigi Proietti ed Enrico Montesano nel sequel del cult degli anni 70. Ancora accanito scommettitore, Mandrake coinvolge un gruppo di buffi complici in una truffa.

programme.title: Poveri ma ricchi
programme.desc: Una squadra di comici, capitanati da Christian De Sica ed Enrico Brignano, per una commedia sull'Italia di oggi. I Tucci sono una numerosa famiglia di un paesino laziale. Da sempre poveri, vincono 100 milioni alla lotteria e la loro vita si trasforma. Per non far sapere di essere i fortunati possessori del biglietto, si trasferiscono in un lussuoso hotel milanese dando vita a un'escalation di risate e a una serie di situazioni paradossali. Diretto da Fausto Brizzi, il film e' un remake di "Les Tuche", grande successo in Francia. Gustoso cameo di Al Bano. Nel cast la grande Anna Mazzamauro.

programme.title: La Trama Fenicia
programme.desc: La commedia di Wes Anderson con Benicio Del Toro segue le vicissitudini di un magnate megalomane e di sua figlia, una giovane novizia. In un vortice di colpi di scena e personaggi caricaturali, i due cercano di portare a termine un folle progetto.

programme.title: Il tuttofare
programme.desc: Sergio Castellitto è il principe del foro nella commedia di Valerio Attanasio. Un giovane praticante in legge sogna un contratto in un prestigioso studio ma finirà in un mare di guai.

programme.desc: Black comedy con Frank Matano nel ruolo di uno strampalato killer per amore. Per riconquistare la sua ex fidanzata, Francesco decide di ucciderle un membro della famiglia.

programme.title: The Notebook
programme.desc:
Behind every great love is a great story.

In Seabrook, South Carolina in the 1940s, teenaged debutante Allie Hamilton and local boy Noah Calhoun spend one passionate, carefree summer together and deeply in love. But when the summer ends, war and duty separate the young couple.

Today, an elderly man visits a nursing home to read from his notebook to a woman whose memory is fading. As he spins a tale of two young lovers with their whole lives before them, his beloved Allie relives a long-ago passion that has never died, an unbreakable bond between two ordinary people rendered extraordinary by the strength, power and beauty of true love.

Based on the novel by Nicholas Sparks, author of A Walk to Remember and Message in a Bottle.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 14
programme.desc: Outraged that he’s being forced to work with university nemesis, Barry Kripke, Sheldon faces a crisis of conscience. Howard and Raj spend a thousand dollars on action figures of themselves.

programme.desc: While the guys try to give their significant others the perfect Valentine’s Day, Raj and Stuart throw a lonely people party at the comic book store.

programme.desc: After a terrible date, Raj vows to never leave his apartment again. Meanwhile, Penny actually impresses Sheldon with her acting skills.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory S6 18
